headline:
Hi! I’m
Asima Aftab.
intro: A safe, compassionate and non-judgmental space to be heard, understood and supported. Together, we can explore your experiences, build emotional resilience and work towards meaningful personal growth.
about: Hello, I’m Asima. I believe that every individual deserves a safe, compassionate and non-judgmental space where they can be heard, understood and supported.
aboutClosing: As a Clinical Psychologist and Psychotherapist, I am passionate about helping individuals understand their emotions, overcome psychological challenges and build healthier relationships with themselves and others.
aboutFull:
My approach focuses on creating a warm and collaborative therapeutic environment where individuals can explore their experiences, develop emotional resilience and work towards meaningful personal growth.
Whether you are experiencing anxiety, depression, stress, trauma-related difficulties, relationship concerns, family conflicts or developmental challenges, my goal is to support you with empathy, professional guidance and practical therapeutic tools.
credentials:
MSc in Psychology
Advanced Diploma in Clinical Psychology (ADCP)
Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Autism Spectrum Disorder
MiCBT Certificate – MiCBT Institute, Australia
Certified MBCT-L (Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life) – Oxford Mindfulness
Certified CBT & Mindfulness – BI, USA
R.P.A.C.P.
Affiliated with the American Psychological Association (APA)
philosophy:
I believe that therapy is not about judging, labelling or changing who you are. It is about understanding yourself, recognising your strengths and developing the skills to navigate life’s challenges.
Every person’s journey is unique, and I value an individualised approach that respects personal experiences, emotional needs and individual differences.
bookingIntro: You deserve to be heard, understood and supported. Taking the first step towards therapy can be the beginning of a meaningful change.
brandTagline: Real Talk. Real Healing. A Healthier You.
